args.integrator:
ROLE: INTEGRATOR of the passing P4 lanes. Time box 90 min. WORK = $SP/work_p4/int1; mirror LOG + patches into MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/p4int1/.
INPUTS (read each lane's HANDOFF.md and its final verdict in MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/p4r1/{rejudge_,judge_}<lane>/ and p4r2/judge_p4hold/):
- env (round 1, base aa7): MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/p4r1/p4env/p4env_vs_aa7.patch (assets.ts, world/Atmos.ts, world/PlateEnvironment.ts, new p4env.ts) + the binary asset LANES/p4env/retrux-web/public/hero/baked/Object_2_010_p4.webp (sha256 3ce65b26...); switch ?p4env=0.
- ice (round 1, base aa7): MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/p4r1/p4ice/p4ice_vs_aa7.patch (hero/IceMaterial.ts only, sha256 8bd774c6...); switch ?p4ice=0.
- orb (round 1, base aa7): MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/p4r1/p4orb/p4orb_vs_aa7.patch (HeroEngine.ts, hero/Orb.ts, hero/Shards.ts, pipeline/PostChain.ts, quality.ts; sha256 986d3bd6...); switch ?p4orb=0.
- hold (round 2, base aa8): the patch in MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/p4r2/p4hold/ (CameraRig.ts, hero/HoldR11.ts, Choreography.ts, HeroEngine.ts); switch ?p4hold=0.
The lanes themselves are in LANES/p4env, p4ice, p4orb, p4hold (their app/ folders are the ground truth if a patch file is ambiguous: verify each patch reproduces its lane from its base first).
STEPS: (1) cp -c -R LANES/aa8 LANES/int1 (aa8's app/ == MAIN's app/ now; verify with diff -r). (2) For every file a lane changed: git merge-file -p <int1 file> <the lane's base file (aa7 or aa8)> <the lane's file>, one lane after another; resolve any conflict by hand keeping BOTH intents; new files and the binary asset copied in. (3) tsc clean (both configs). (4) Serve int1 on :5173 (PORT=5173 nohup node hero-lab/serve.mjs --no-watch). (5) Switch proofs with ident (final + all targets + every program, 20 moving frames): ?p4env=0&p4ice=0&p4orb=0&p4hold=0 == :5199 (MAIN = AA8) at T1, T2, T0 phone and ?envlake=plate; each lane's key effect survived in int1 (env: no iceberg / far-peak ghost in the sideways orbit spots with contrast-stretched zooms; ice: q00 / q03 / p05 crops equal to the ice lane's final within noise; orb: orb / shard crops equal to the orb lane's final; hold: p04-p08 framing equal to the hold lane's). (6) Perf: real loop interleaved A/B int1 vs :5199 (rest, idle loop and hold; >= 6 pairs; SLOT_BG=0; load < 10). (7) The full panel capture set: zsh /Users/muhamadrifaldi/RetruxR11Work/hp/qc_r11.zsh $SP/p3/r11_2 http://localhost:5173 T1 1 (this is what the next panel will judge), and LOOK at cmp_q00_rest, cmp_q03_eye, cmp_p05_expand, cmp_p06_sustain and two pointer spots yourself. (8) Write int1_vs_main.patch (diff -u --label a/retrux-web/<f> --label b/retrux-web/<f> against LANES/aa8, all changed files + new files) and apply-test it on a fresh clone of aa8 (0 .orig / .rej, reproduces int1's app/, tsc clean); list binary assets separately with sha256. Leave :5173 running. Never edit MAIN or any other lane.
args.verifier: ROLE: independent VERIFIER of the integration (lane int1, lab :5173; read-only, never restart :5173 / :5199). Time box 45 min. Folder $SP/work_p4/verify_int1; mirror into MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/p4int1/verify/. Check: the switch proofs (re-run the all-off ident yourself vs :5199 at T1 and T0); for each lane, that its effect survived and that nothing of another lane broke it (side-by-side crops int1 vs each lane's final captures in $SP/work_p4/<lane>/qc_final or qc_fix, and vs MAIN's $SP/p3/r11_1); a glitch hunt on $SP/p3/r11_2 (all 10 pointer spots + the sweep; contrast-stretched zooms where the panel found glitches); console lines 0; tsc; the patch applies to a fresh aa8 clone and reproduces int1; perf numbers re-measured once. ok = true only if no blocker / major is found and every switch proof holds. Look at every image you cite.
